title: EdgeNOS switch-ASIC entry
description: One switch silicon EdgeNOS can drive. Referenced by platform entries via their 'asic' field.

sdk.description: Which SDK stack drives this ASIC ('none' = no switch silicon: Linux software datapath).

sdk_chip.description: SDK chip variant the symbols come from, e.g. 'bcm56840_b0'.

datapath.description: Default datapath daemon package for this ASIC, e.g. 'edged', 'bcmd' (platform may override).

kernel_modules.description: BDE/KNET kernel modules this ASIC needs.

on_die_cpu.description: True if the host CPU is on-die (SoC, no external PCIe), e.g. Helix4 iProc.

reference.description: Pointer to register/RE docs for this ASIC.
